hypotheses.description: The two products are spatially misaligned (e.g., a shift or rotation) causing low agreement despite both being valid.
A transformation (e.g., scaling, projection, or unit conversion) was applied incorrectly to one product, altering values systematically.
The two products are generated by different algorithms or processing chains that legitimately produce different spatial patterns, so agreement is inherently low.
One or both products contain high noise or outliers that reduce agreement without a systematic fault.
The valid pixel mask is incorrect, causing comparison over pixels that should be excluded (e.g., clouds, land/water boundaries).

selected_experiment.expected_evidence: agreement after shifting one product by 1 column; if agreement increases substantially, supports H001 (misalignment); if unchanged, weakens H001
